title: SignConnect inference prediction response v1
description: Strict inference-to-realtime result correlated to one request and window. Mock metadata prevents synthetic output from being presented as validated SGSL recognition.

windowSequence.description: The request window sequence echoed unchanged.

labelId.description: A stable ASCII classifier label identifier.

captionText.description: Proposed display text for a recognized label, or null for NO_SIGN/no caption.

confidence.description: Finite classifier confidence in the inclusive range 0 through 1.

modelVersion.description: A non-sensitive model artifact version identifier.

inferenceLatencyMs.description: Finite inference latency in milliseconds; excludes network and stabilization time.

mockModel.description: True only for the deterministic synthetic integration model.
